connected.title: Connected
connected.subtitle: You are signed in to Confluence

panel.title: Authentication
panel.subtitle: Sign in with SSO or use a manual fallback

fields.confluenceUrlPlaceholder: https://your-company.atlassian.net or full wiki page URL

sso.cookieModeHint: Using session cookie below — SSO window will not open. Click Save Cookie after pasting cookies from DevTools.
sso.defaultHint: Opens Confluence in a secure browser window. Complete IdP login there, then use the main app to open your target page and confirm.
sso.inProgressDescription: Complete login in the SSO window. When the wiki page loads as signed in, this app will detect the session and connect automatically.
sso.idpHint: If IdP login finishes without redirecting back to wiki, click Open target page to load Confluence in the SSO window.

manual.title: Manual fallback
manual.subtitle: Use API token or session cookie when SSO is unavailable.
manual.apiTokenHint: Generate API token at Atlassian Account → Security → API tokens
manual.cookieHint: In DevTools → Application → Cookies for wiki.heytea.com, copy the full header (must include seraph.confluence, not only JSESSIONID). Then click Save Cookie — this does not open SSO.

connectedActions.sessionHint: Session expired or API errors? Sign in again with SSO, update your session cookie, or log out.
connectedActions.cookieDevToolsHint: Copy cookies from browser DevTools after signing in to Confluence in your browser.
